headline: Cognizant (CTSH) Could Be Near A Growth Turnaround As Q2 Results Loom
summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions is set to report Q2 results that some analysts see as the start of a major turnaround in its growth profile. The update comes with NasdaqGS:CTSH trading at $43.01 ahead of the earnings release. Investors are watching closely for signs that the company’s business performance is stabilizing after a prolonged period of weaker returns.
